title: Malicious code in @cexy/wonfca (npm)
description: The npm package @cexy/wonfca, which claims to provide a Facebook Chat API, contains malicious code that routes user authentication credentials through a hardcoded third-party server (https://minhdong.site) controlled by the package author. When users invoke the package's login function, their Facebook email, password, and two-factor authentication data are sent via HTTP POST to this unauthorized server. This server then intermediates the login process, capturing live Facebook session tokens and cookies, effectively compromising user credentials and sessions.
